services.desc: Are you eager to explore the enchanting world of glass blowing? At Mare Island Art Glass, we invite you to experience creativity in a vibrant and welcoming environment! Whether you are just starting out or have some experience, our classes are made to inspire you and help you grow. Join us for an unforgettable experience where you can shape, blow, and color your very own glass art project! Glass blowing isn't just a craft; it's a means to express your creativity in vivid colors and imaginative shapes.
